movie.title: Where Is Your Faith
movie.overview: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a dark church on a quiet night, a desperate woman contemplating suicide and a grieving pastor struggling with his own lost conviction help each other confront hope.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Desperate and overwhelmed, Sarah Mitchell enters a quiet, darkened church with the intent to end her life. Inside, she encounters Pastor David Reynolds, who is quietly enduring his own severe crisis of faith and loss. Brought together in a moment of mutual spiritual isolation, the two begin an honest conversation about their pain. Through their unexpected encounter, both characters find the strength to confront their despair and rediscover hope.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: On a quiet and heavy night, Sarah Mitchell reaches her absolute breaking point and steps into a dark, empty church, prepared to take her own life. Unbeknownst to her, Pastor David Reynolds is already inside, grappling with a profound personal crisis and the agonizing loss of his own faith. When David discovers Sarah in the sanctuary, he steps in not as a spiritual authority, but as a fellow human suffering through deep sorrow. As they open up to one another, Sarah reveals the immense pain driving her to end her life, while David confesses his own doubts and feelings of abandonment by God. Their raw, transparent conversation forces both of them to confront the grief and disillusionment they have been carrying alone. Instead of offering easy answers, David listens with deep empathy, finding his own pastoral purpose reawakened by Sarah's urgent need for comfort. In turn, Sarah sees that she is not alone in her brokenness, finding a glimmer of light in David's honest struggle. By the end of the night, their shared vulnerability anchors them back to life, offering a quiet yet powerful testament to the healing power of shared faith and human connection.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell enters a dark, empty church carrying a burden so heavy she is prepared to end her life. Expecting solitude, she instead encounters Pastor David Reynolds, a man of God who is secretly fighting his own internal battle and a devastating loss of faith. As these two wounded souls cross paths in the quiet sanctuary, they engage in a raw and emotionally charged dialogue about suffering, doubt, and redemption. 'Where Is Your Faith' is a poignant narrative that explores how unexpected human connection can illuminate the darkest moments and restore a sense of hope when all seems lost.

story_structure.climax: In a pivotal emotional confrontation, they directly face their deepest grief and choices, deciding whether to succumb to hopelessness or reach for redemption.
story_structure.conflict: Both characters face intense internal crises—Sarah feels driven to end her life, while Pastor David questions his calling and ability to offer spiritual guidance.
story_structure.resolution: Through mutual vulnerability, Sarah and David begin to rediscover purpose, opening a path toward healing, renewed hope, and restored faith.
story_structure.introduction: Sarah enters a quiet, darkened church in a state of deep personal despair, while Pastor David struggles silently with his own fading faith.
story_structure.risingAction: An unintended middle-of-the-night encounter brings the two together, forcing them to share their pain, exchange raw truths, and grapple with their shared doubts.
